selection_basis: Dedicated translation model supporting every requested language; developer-reported 46-language comparisons include TranslateGemma. This is not proof of superiority on this bank. Existing 993 pairs used the same pinned model; preserves translator consistency.
qa: Qwen2.5-32B semantic comparison of original, translation and backtranslation; model judgments are not human gold. Failed translations are retained and excluded from accepted inputs.
normalization: Chinese is the grid label; translation prompts use the officially supported name Chinese (Simplified).
